 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return merged identifiers and the number already present on this author."""
+        existing = self.get('remote_ids') or {}
+        matches = 0
+        for kind, value in incoming_ids.items():
+            if kind in existing:
+                if existing[kind] != value:
+                    raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                        f"Conflicting {kind} author remote ID: {existing[kind]!r} != {value!r}"

+        return dict(existing) | incoming_ids, matches

 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return merged identifiers and the number already present on this author."""
+        existing = self.get('remote_ids') or {}
+        matches = 0
+        for kind, value in incoming_ids.items():
+            if kind in existing:
+                if existing[kind] != value:
+                    raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                        f"Conflicting {kind} author remote ID: {existing[kind]!r} != {value!r}"
+                    )
+                matches += 1
+        return dict(existing) | incoming_ids, matches
